name: Pirate's Treasure Pineapple-Coconut Ice Cream Sundae (Pirate Night)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Pirate Night Menu
whyItWorks: Rum-raisin or vanilla ice cream with pineapple compote and coconut cookies—citrus-free, though pineapple fibers and raisins need care.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain vanilla ice cream with caramel/fudge instead of the fibrous pineapple-raisin compote if flaring.
